evidence.requirements: All brief items met. Start page shows title, date/time, price and '<n> seats left' (TastingCard.tsx:24,34,40; start.jpg). 'Book <title>' link (TastingCard.tsx:53). Booking form has Name/Email/Guests (1-8) fields and a Book button (BookingForm.tsx:68,84,100,124). Seat limit enforced with a 409 error on the guests field (guest.ts:29-33). Errors appear next to their field (form.jpg). Confirmation has the 'Booking confirmed' heading, tasting, guests, total and reference (ConfirmationPage.tsx:56-69; confirmation.jpg). /staff has a Password field and Sign in button, with the password from STAFF_PASSWORD (config.ts:20). Bookings grouped by tasting with a Cancel button that frees seats (staff.ts:78-94; staff.jpg). Built with React, Express and Tailwind; PORT defaults to 3000; bookings kept in memory.
evidence.correctness: Seat check and insert happen in one synchronous step (booking-store.ts:32-46), and a concurrency test exists (bookings-api.test.ts:82-93). Seats left are computed from active bookings, so cancelling frees seats (tastings.ts:50-55). References are never reused after cancel (booking-store.ts:29,66-75). One shared zod schema is used on client and server; tests cover 0, 9, 2.5, NaN, string guests and whitespace-only names (booking-schema.test.ts:46-58). Seats are refreshed after a 409 (BookingPage.tsx:99). Minor slips: the comment at presenters.ts:6 says emails never pass through, but toStaffBookingRow includes them; the staff view shows '0 seats left' instead of 'Fully booked' (StaffOverview.tsx:100).
evidence.security: Password compared with timingSafeEqual on SHA-256 digests (staff-auth.ts:10-14). Session cookie is signed, HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict with an 8-hour expiry (staff.ts:30-39). Sign-in rate limited to 10 failures per 15 minutes (staff.ts:42-49). Helmet CSP and frame-deny, a 10kb JSON limit (app.ts:20-30), and no-store on staff responses (staff.ts:25-28). The public confirmation omits name and email (presenters.ts:20-28). React escapes all output; no secrets in code. Remaining gaps, both documented in the README: guest bookings are not rate limited, and sessions cannot be revoked on the server.
evidence.code_quality: Clear split between shared, server and client code. Strict TypeScript with noUncheckedIndexedAccess. Discriminated unions model results and page load states. Error handling is consistent: a JSON error handler on the server (app.ts:56-70) and a typed ApiResult on the client (client/api.ts:9-42). Files are small, well named and properly sized for the task.
evidence.tests: About 25 test files: Supertest API tests, Testing Library component tests and shared unit tests. They cover the exact labels and button names from the brief, field-level errors with accessible descriptions (booking-page.test.tsx:53-93), the seat limit and fully booked state (bookings-api.test.ts:62-80), concurrent bookings, cancel freeing seats (staff-api.test.ts:101-117), 401 auth checks, session expiry with fake timers, and the sign-in rate limit (staff-auth.test.ts). No browser end-to-end test.
evidence.ux_design: Coherent winery look: burgundy and cream with serif headings, clear cards, a scannable confirmation and a tidy staff list (start.jpg, confirmation.jpg, staff.jpg). Responsive classes for phones. Fully booked badges and disabled form exist in code (TastingCard.tsx:18-21, BookingPage.tsx:89-95). Weaknesses: the invalid Email field in form.jpg shows a gold focus border instead of the red error border (fieldClass.ts:4-5); Cancel acts immediately with no confirmation; error text is small.
evidence.accessibility: Real labels tied to inputs, a skip link, landmarks and nav aria-label (Layout.tsx). aria-invalid and aria-describedby on fields; react-hook-form focuses the first invalid field; role=alert for errors and role=status for loading and success (Notice.tsx:15). Problems: the gold eyebrow text #b8912f on #f8f3e8 is about 2.7:1, failing the 4.5:1 text contrast (StartPage.tsx:33, StaffPage.tsx:34); inputs use outline-none, leaving only a low-contrast gold border as the focus cue (fieldClass.ts:3-4).
evidence.simplicity: Mainstream, well-fitting dependencies: Express, zod, react-hook-form, react-router, Tailwind, helmet, cookie-session, express-rate-limit. The code size is reasonable for the scope. A few extras (config warnings, SECURE_COOKIES flag, issuedReferences set) are justified but add some surface.
evidence.maintainability: Present: a strong README covering run steps, environment variables, security model, data, API and layout; package-lock.json; lint, typecheck and test scripts; a comprehensive regression suite. Missing: no CI pipeline; openspec/specs contains only .gitkeep; no ADRs or decision docs; no changelog or release process beyond version 1.0.0; Node not pinned (engines '>=22', no .nvmrc); no staff guide beyond a short README section.

strengths: Meets every brief requirement exactly, with correct seat accounting, cancellation and a server-side seat limit that holds under concurrent requests
Solid security: constant-time password comparison, signed HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie session, sign-in rate limit, helmet CSP and no-store on staff data
Thorough, meaningful tests across API, components and shared logic that check the brief's exact labels, errors and edge cases
issues: Maintainability gaps: no CI pipeline, empty openspec/specs, no ADRs or changelog, Node version not pinned
Accessibility contrast: gold eyebrow text is about 2.7:1, and inputs remove the outline so the focus cue is a low-contrast gold border that also hides the red error border (form.jpg)

Minor UX and correctness gaps: Cancel has no confirmation, the staff view shows no 'Fully booked' state, guest bookings are not rate limited (documented), and the comment at presenters.ts:6 is inaccurate
review.verdict: A polished, well-tested and secure booking app that fully meets the brief and looks like a small winery's own site. It is ready to ship once the contrast and focus styling are fixed and a CI pipeline and decision docs are added for long-term upkeep.
